# Pull Request

## Outcome

Describe the user or programme outcome this change advances.

## Evidence and scope

Link the Beads issue, governing decision or specification, reviewed repositories
and commits, and any deployed evidence. State what is intentionally out of scope.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results.

## Dependencies and follow-up

Link blockers or discovered work in Beads.
